reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: The canonical cover is a gray Raiden with feet apart, BOTH arms spread at waist level, no obvious staff, standing on a round stone temple pedestal flanked by symmetric braziers. Source images 1–8 show a blue-clad Raiden raising ONE arm over his head to hold a skull or lightning effect, the other hand holding a staff angled diagonally over a narrow jagged rocky base. Pose, hand props, clothing silhouette, base shape and additional lightning accessories differ. These are not proven identical sculptures; historic Mortal Kombat variants must still be investigated.
